ANTR 201
Exploring Cultural Artifacts
The course offers students a chance to study the remnants of
past civilizations. Field trips include visits to the National
Museum and the university’s Archaeology Museum. Students
will analyze artifacts up close and assess their artistic and
cultural significance in detailed written reports.
Prerequisite: Intro to Archaeology.
